en.html:
First aid for the wounded. Arrangements to get them to the hospital. The attackers handed over to the police. All this and the other necessary work had to be settled before we returned to Horigoe.

By then the late-autumn sun had already gone down.
The three of us passed through the dim gate. From anyone's mouth, not one word.
